purpose: Connect a moved measurement to the fitted line, its slope and all its residuals.
meaning: Ordinary least squares chooses line parameters that minimize the sum of squared vertical residuals. A residual is an observed response minus its fitted response. This family refits five constructed seedling heights whenever the final height changes.

definition.setting: Five constructed seedling measurements have days x=(1,2,3,4,5) and heights y=(2,3,5,4,h) cm. Move the final height and refit an intercept and slope by ordinary least squares.
definition.formal_latex: \hat y_i=a+bx_i,\quad b=\frac{\sum_i(x_i-\bar x)(y_i-\bar y)}{\sum_i(x_i-\bar x)^2},\quad a=\bar y-b\bar x,\quad SSE=\sum_i(y_i-\hat y_i)^2.

signature.b: Fitted slope in cm per day.

conditions: Five constructed seedling measurements have days x=(1,2,3,4,5) and heights y=(2,3,5,4,h) cm. Move the final height and refit an intercept and slope by ordinary least squares.

The fitted line minimizes vertical squared residuals for these five measurements. No causal growth law, extrapolation guarantee or regression uncertainty interval is inferred. The day values remain distinct, so the fit is defined.
